pendingApprovalRequestTemplate.reasoning: The step of reasoning or user-facing goal that led the agent here — not a paraphrase, the model's actual stated intent.

approval.reason: Order ID does not match expected format — likely malformed input.

result.toolResultContent: Human reviewer declined this action: order ID looks malformed.

fieldNotes.requestId / toolUseId: requestId is your own internal pending-request record; toolUseId ties it back to the exact Claude API tool_use block it came from (Lesson 25).
fieldNotes.reasoning: This is what lets a reviewer judge intent, not just mechanics — show it verbatim, not a summary you wrote yourself.
fieldNotes.approval.decision: Only 'approved' or 'rejected' — a rejection is NOT the same as a tool execution error; your code worked correctly, the action was simply declined (Lesson 25).
fieldNotes.result.toolResultIsError: Set true on a rejection so Claude's next turn correctly treats the action as not-having-happened, not as a success (Lesson 25).
fieldNotes.appendOnly: Every entry here is written once and never edited in place. A correction is a NEW entry referencing the original requestId, never a mutation (Lesson 27).
fieldNotes.whatGetsLogged: Every call — approved, rejected, AND ungated (e.g. get_order) — gets one entry. Logging only successes hides the exact evidence that your checkpoints are working (Lesson 27).
